Perks › Legendary

Table Whisperer

Legendary perk · Information

Play locations reveal whether they expand or restrict your opponent's legal options.

In-game card text

How it works

While you hold a bone, each place you could play it shows whether that play would give Rival more, fewer or the same number of playable bones, judged against Rival's real rack.

  • With two or more copies it shows the exact difference, such as "Rival plays −2".

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeInformation
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Play 500 bones; Win 50 hands; Build a 10-play run), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
